mapper.select: select d.paper_id as "paperId", p.paper_name as "paperName", p.exam_date as "examDate", case when sum(d.full_score) > 0 then sum(d.score) / sum(d.full_score) else null end as "rate" from spas_score_detail d join spas_paper p on p.paper_id = d.paper_id where d.student_id = #{studentId} AND p.subject_id = #{subjectId} group by d.paper_id, p.paper_name, p.exam_date order by p.exam_date desc nulls last, d.paper_id desc limit #{limit}
select distinct student_id from spas_score_detail where paper_id = #{paperId}
